Registration tutorial

  1. wait for this verification mail and open the link above;
  2. after the verification succeeds, the page shows a base64 authorization code;
  3. copy the code and save it locally with the xGet command line:
    xGet activate --server {{server}} --email {{email}} --code <the base64 code>
  4. upload your packages afterwards: xGet upload --server {{server}} --email {{email}} --file <package.nupkg>
